sentences.text: Rahul Solanki appearing on behalf of Advocate General.

1.
Heard on I.A. No.1400/2026, which is repeat 6th application for suspension of jail sentence filed on behalf of the appellant.

2. Earlier, 5th application of the appellant was dismissed on merits on 03.12.2025 by observing as under:
"Heard on I.A.No.16277/2025, which is 5th repeat application seeking suspension of sentence of appellant/accused.

The appellant has been convicted under sections 376(2)(n) & 376(2)(i) of the IPC and under section 6 read with section 5(l) of the POCSO Act, 2012 and has been sentenced to 10 years RI under section 376(2)(n) and 10 years RI under section 376(2)
(i) of the IPC.
The sentences have been ordered to run concurrently.
This 5th application has been preferred on the ground that appellant has suffered approximately 4 years in jail.
Vide order dated 05.10.2024 of I.A.No.12213/2024 he was given liberty to renew the 2 CRA-12326-2022 prayer after six months.
The trial court committed error in convicting the appellant.
The trial court committed error in not considering the fact that the complainant malafidely implicated the appellant.
There is no apprehension that he will abscond in the case.
The appellant has been convicted for committing aggravated penetrative sexual assault with a child of 13 years.
First application of the appellant was dismissed vide order dated 27.06.2023 on merits.

Thereafter,
second application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 04.03.2024 and third application was dismissed as withdrawn on 15.10.2024.

The fourth application was dismissed vide order dated 09.09.2025 with the following observation:

sentences.text: There is aggravated penetrative sexual assault by 27 years old M.B.A. graduate (Exhibit-P/10) with a child (PW-2) born on 29.03.2023 and she was below the age of 13 on the date of incident i.e. 22.02.2016 and the grounds raised were already considered on 27.06.2023 and rejected the application on merits and thereafter there is no sufficient period of 3 CRA-12326-2022 custody warranting suspension.
Accordingly this repeat application is hereby dismissed at present.
Period of custody is only 3 years one month and twenty days.
Considering the nature of offence and the fact that the grounds raised by the appellant have already been considered, no case for suspension of sentence is made out.
Accordingly, IA No.16277/2025 is rejected."
3. During the course of arguments, counsel for the appellant could not point out any change of circumstance.
Hence, at present, no case of suspension of jail sentence is made out.
Accordingly, the application is rejected.
List the matter in due course.
